text: Good morning — Professor Alvarez here. One question before I book something: I've been told that Diego's CSE451 lecture this Wednesday (18 November) at 10:00 is cancelled. Can the office confirm that in writing? If it is cancelled, I'd like to put a 30-minute advising meeting with Diego in that slot, Wednesday 10:00-10:30. Thank you.

Good morning, Professor Alvarez. I can confirm the opposite: the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 18 November, 10:00–11:00, is on the official department schedule and has **not** been cancelled or moved. There is no written cancellation for it, and a cancellation counts only when this office announces it.

So that slot is taken, and a lecture is not dropped for a 1:1 meeting. I don't arrange other people's meetings — if you'd like to meet Diego, please fix it with him directly, in free time outside the scheduled teaching.

And while you're at it: could you send me my own official schedule for this week (lectures, sections, office hours, faculty senate, committees, department meetings)? I want to be sure I don't put a student meeting on top of a teaching or governance duty.

I can't produce a personal schedule: the office keeps the official department schedule, not each person's private appointments, and I don't share anyone's commitments. What I can give you is the official schedule for next week, which is public:

- Mon 09:00–10:00 TA section
- Mon 10:00–11:30 CSE444 lecture
- Tue 09:30–11:00 CSE452 lecture
- Wed 09:00–10:00 CSE444 lecture
- Wed 10:00–11:00 CSE451 lecture
- Thu 09:00–10:30 CSE452 lecture
- Thu 11:00–12:00 CSE455 office hours
- Thu 14:00–15:30 Seminar
- Fri 10:30–12:00 CSE444 lecture

Nothing in it is cancelled or moved. Your own calendar is the record of your commitments — check it against these times.
Thank you — that settles it. I will not treat that slot as free, and I won't act on a cancellation that the office has not announced. Still waiting for my own schedule for this week when you have it.

Glad that's settled. There's nothing to wait for on the personal schedule: the office keeps only the official department schedule (that's the list I sent), not individual calendars and not private appointments. Your own calendar is the record of your commitments — that is where your week is written down, and it is what should be checked against the official times above.

Hi Diego — Professor Alvarez. I wanted to book a 30-minute advising meeting with you this week, and my note said Wednesday 10:00 was free because your CSE451 lecture that hour was cancelled.

I checked with the department office before acting on it: they confirm the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 18 November, 10:00–11:00, is **not** cancelled. So that hour is taken and I won't book over it.

When are you free this week for 30 minutes — outside your lectures, sections and TA duties? Tell me a couple of windows and I'll pick one and put it on both our calendars.

Thanks for checking with the office before planning around it — appreciated. And thanks for the note about the CSE451 hour: I'll leave Wednesday 10:00–11:00 alone then.

For 30 minutes, a few windows that are free on my side this week (all inside working hours):

- **Wednesday 18 Nov, 12:30–13:00** (or anywhere up to 14:00)
- **Thursday 19 Nov, 12:00–13:00**
- **Friday 20 Nov, 12:00–13:00** (also 16:00–17:00)

Thursday or Friday midday would suit me best. Pick whichever works for you and I'll put it on my calendar — I keep the advisor 1:1 Wednesday 14:00–15:00 as it is, so no need to touch that one.

One thing for next time: if a session looks cancelled, a written confirmation from the department office is the only thing I'll act on.

One more, and it's factual: the list you sent was for **next** week. What official events are on the department schedule for **this** week, Wed 18 – Fri 20 November? Specifically, is there any official event (lecture, section, seminar, office hours, senate, committee or department meeting) on **Thursday 19 November, 12:00–13:00**? I'm considering booking an advising meeting with Diego then and don't want to sit on a teaching or governance duty.

Thanks — that's a good rule and I'll keep to it.

Thursday 19 Nov, 12:00–13:00 suits me best too. I'm doing one last factual check with the office that nothing official sits on that hour for me this week (the list they sent me was for next week), and then I'll log it and it's fixed. If that hour turns out to be taken I'll come back with Friday 12:00–13:00 instead.

Noted about your Wednesday 14:00–15:00 advisor slot — I won't touch it.

Thursday 19 Nov, 12:00–13:00 it is — I'll hold that hour and leave the rest as is. I'll put it on my calendar and log it as soon as you confirm the office says nothing official sits on it for you; if it turns out taken, Friday 20 Nov 12:00–13:00 is my fallback.

Just send me one line either way and we're fixed.

I only have the one official department schedule, and it is the one I sent — the days in it are the department's days, not a separate next-week list: Wednesday 10:00–11:00 CSE451 is the Wednesday 18 November event I confirmed to you a moment ago. No event in it has been cancelled or moved.

On Thursday 19 November: the official events that day are CSE452 09:00–10:30, CSE455 office hours 11:00–12:00 and the Seminar 14:00–15:30. At **12:00–13:00 there is no official event** — no lecture, section, seminar, office hours, senate, committee or department meeting. (CSE455 office hours are open to students, so they are not a booked advising slot anyway.)

That does not tell you whether the time is free in Diego's calendar or yours, and I don't book other people's meetings — fix it with Diego and put it on both calendars if you agree.
Noted — Thursday 19 Nov 12:00–13:00 held on your side, Friday 12:00–13:00 as fallback. I'll send you the one line as soon as the office answers.
That's exactly what I needed — thank you. Logged: advising meeting with Diego, Thursday 19 November, 12:00–12:30, no official event in that hour.

One line as promised: the office confirms no official event for either of us on Thursday 19 Nov, 12:00–13:00 — so **Thursday 19 Nov, 12:00–12:30** it is. It's on my calendar now; put it on yours and we're fixed. Friday 12:00–13:00 stays as fallback if anything moves.

Noted. One thing for the record: a meeting is booked only when every participant has it on their calendar — so that slot counts as booked once Diego also has it, and every change should be logged. Nothing official stands in that hour.
Done — Thursday 19 Nov 12:00–12:30 is on my calendar and logged. Friday 12:00–13:00 noted as fallback. See you Thursday.
Both calendars and logged. See you Thursday.
Nothing further needed on that one — the official schedule you sent is what I used, and the meeting is booked and logged. Thank you.
